description: Run your own commands and webhooks when BB threads change state, and hold each outgoing message to your own policy. Install notification, integration, automation and guard templates from the marketplace catalog, each rated for performance and security, or write hooks by hand. React to thread lifecycle events with filters on project, provider, title and text; gate hooks proceed, reject with a reason, or wait before dispatch. Secrets stay AES-256-GCM encrypted and are referenced without storing values in hook definitions; manage everything from the Hooks page, `bb hooks`, or the bundled agent skills. Commands run on the machine hosting the BB server with the server user's access.
